review.market_summary: 1) Rates are being repriced hawkishly. October payrolls beat (+165k, unemployment 4.1%) and pushed the odds of a December hike past 65%. October CPI is the next catalyst and the biggest risk this week. 2) The AI/semis trade is under pressure from two directions: the Jensen Huang personal scandal, which now carries a national-security angle, and post-election headlines saying the "AI trade" is getting hammered. Semis and the smaller AI cloud providers (CoreWeave, Nebius) are already down 9–16% in 5 days, so much of the move has happened. 3) The Middle East is escalating: Houthi strikes on Riyadh, a US strike near Qeshm, and the US rejecting Iran's ceasefire terms. But oil and energy stocks have fallen about 12% in a week and futures rallied on cheaper oil. The market isn't paying for the conflict, so I'm not betting against that price action. Overall I'm keeping few trades, because most candidates repeat the same rates bet or chase moves that have already happened.
